notes.note: Retschko got plenty of the footy with 23 disposals. He was under pressure and went at 69% efficiency holding his score down a little.
24 disposals for Retschko as he was amongst the highest possessions getters for the Tigers but in the wet conditions his 50% efficiency did hurt his score.
24 touches for Retschko as he did well in the Tigers win.  We just need a consistent level of scoring for him which will come with experience.
This was his lowest in the last 5 games. We have seen some wild variations in his scoring but this is what we get with rookies so the best option is if you can loop him.
Huge from Retschko with 19 touches a goal and 6 marks. This is now two over 100 in the last four weeks for him. Unfortunately they don't play enough early games for him to be a loop option.
18 touches for Retschko with this a good bounce back from last week. His scoring is just not consistent enough to trust on field.
Quiet one for Retschko with 15 disposals at 60%. His scoring hasn't been consistent lately as he can be really hot or really cold game to game.

Retschko was the only Tiger to hit triple figures with his 26 disposals and 10 marks. This was just the second over 100 this season for him. He could be traded for some value but really he will be a good one to have as your bench cover.
Retschko was again under 100 this week and is losing money at a fast rate now.
Two in the 40s for Retschko now and his BE has risen to 95 so with some cheap mid season draft guys coming through it is time to offload the young Tiger.
Retschko struggled having just 10 disposals and his lowest score so far. This is an issue for owners hoping for cash generation as his BE has risen to 31.
Retschko had 27 disposals and 8 marks with this being his best score of the season. He now has a BE that has dropped to 11 and his spot is solid in this team. With the good bye he is a great hold.

Solid game from Retschko despite being his lowest for the year. He isn't dominating but is doing enough for us to rise in value. If we can get a bit more from him and see him keep his spot in the byes that would be great.
Retschko was great for owners with his 22 disposals at 81%. This saw his BE remain low at 9 and a great pick. He is still going to make us some good money.
Retschko had the 9 touches and whilst his score wasn't as big as his first couple it was certainly ok for a cash cow. His BE remains very favourable so nothing to be concerned about.
Retschko was even better in his second game. He is a must trade in this week. He had 26 disposals and 6 contested possessions.

First game for Retschko and it was a good one with 6 marks and 13 disposals. He look like he could be a good downgrade but if you can wait let's see what happens next week in game two. With the Tigers injuries he should hold his spot.
